reviews.body: Ivonne is by far the best and has the best hands. I’m pretty sure I fell asleep on the table bc I was so relaxed. Do yourself a favor and book that massage, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Dionara H…
reviews.body: I had an amazing experience. She was incredibly kind and genuinely concerned about my target and problem areas. She took her time, went above and beyond to help relieve the tension and pain I’ve been dealing with, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire session. I left feeling so much better. I’ll definitely be back and plan on becoming a regular.
